Official 49ers Week 9 Injury Report

hardFacts: Nick Bosa returns Sunday vs. Las Vegas for the first time since Week 2 without a restrictive game designation after clearing post-Bye full-speed pass-rush reps.
Christian McCaffrey exited the Week 8 Bye off the injury report and is a full go for Sunday at Levi's Stadium (1:25 PM PT, FOX).
Week 9 marks the first snap sequence pairing Nick Bosa and Keion White on the edges with newly re-acquired DeForest Buckner and Osa Odighizuwa (#92) at 3-tech / 2i interior alignments.
schemeAndCapTakeaways: Pass-Rush Stunt Geometry: Having both Buckner (6'7", 34.4" arms) and Odighizuwa inside forces opposing protections to slide interior help, isolating Bosa 1-on-1 on the Wide-9 rail without needing 5-man pressures.

Run-Fit Impact vs. Raiders Outside Zone: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak runs heavy wide-zone/boot action with Kirk Cousins, Ashton Jeanty, and Brock Bowers; Buckner's vertical knock-back disrupts playside combo climbs to Fred Warner.
clusteredBriefs.consensusVsDissent: Unanimous beat consensus that SF will still manage Bosa around 42–48 snaps (~68% share) in his first game back, rotating Bryce Huff, Keion White, and rookie Romello Height on early run downs.

Brandon Aiyuk Contract & Cap Breakdown — OverTheCap

hardFacts: Brandon Aiyuk and agent Drew Rosenhaus met with 49ers leadership at SAP Performance Facility on Friday, Nov 6, stating he is physically healthy and seeking reinstatement; NFL Network notes ~$13M in bonus forfeiture complicates a simple release.

With Aiyuk (Personal), Deebo Samuel Sr. (Hamstring), Mike Evans (Achilles), and Christian Kirk (Knee - Meniscus) ruled Out for Week 9—and Ricky Pearsall + rookie De'Zhaun Stribling on IR—Kyle Shanahan signaled Demarcus Robinson (Questionable, Ankle) is likely to be activated from IR.
Under OverTheCap's 2026 ledger ($35.16M gross cap space), any Post-June 1 trade or release keeps current-year proration on 2026 while deferring remaining future bonus acceleration into 2027.
schemeAndCapTakeaways: Cap Math Reality: Because prorated signing/option bonus acceleration after June 1 splits remaining future-year proration into 2027 dead money, resolving Aiyuk's contract preserves 2026 cap room ($35.16M) while bilateral forfeiture language determines 2027 dead-cap relief.

On-Field Week 9 WR Rotation: Brandin Cooks (#84), Jordan Watkins, Jacob Cowing (#4), and likely IR-activation Demarcus Robinson handle 11-personnel WR snaps alongside high-volume 21/12-personnel focal points George Kittle and Christian McCaffrey.
clusteredBriefs.consensusVsDissent: National insiders (Schefter/Pelissero/Maiocco/Barrows) note Friday's NFL personnel notice included no immediate reinstatement, pointing toward a structured trade or settlement rather than immediate snap reintegration.

Raiders vs. 49ers Week 9 Matchup & Injury Gamecast — ESPN

hardFacts: The 6-1 49ers (1st in NFC West • #1 Seed in NFC, +58 (197 PF / 139 PA)) enter Week 9 with a +7-day rest advantage off their Week 8 Bye as 10.0-point home favorites (51.5 O/U, 1:25 PM PT on FOX) vs. Las Vegas (4-4).
Raiders first-year HC Klint Kubiak served on Kyle Shanahan's 2023 NFC Championship staff as Passing Game Specialist and enters off a 38-33 Week 8 win behind QB Kirk Cousins and TE Brock Bowers.
Through 7 games, Brock Purdy & the 49ers offense rank top-3 in Passing EPA (+63.23) and CPOE (+4.25%), averaging 8.28 yards per pass attempt with only 7 sacks allowed (3.2% sack rate, #2 NFL).
schemeAndCapTakeaways: Neutralizing Maxx Crosby (#98): Expect heavy 21-personnel chip-and-release help from George Kittle and Kyle Juszczyk on right tackle Colton McKivitz's edge whenever Crosby flips away from Trent Williams.

Defending Kubiak's 12-Personnel Boot/Crossers: Las Vegas pairs Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer with Kirk Cousins play-action; Fred Warner and Deommodore Lenoir have hundreds of Santa Clara practice reps diagnosing those exact spacing rules.
clusteredBriefs.consensusVsDissent: Film analysts highlight Las Vegas's vulnerability defending middle-of-field seam/choice routes against linebackers (Nakobe Dean / Quay Walker)—prime territory for Kittle and McCaffrey option routes.

San Francisco 49ers 2026–2029 Salary Cap Table — OverTheCap

hardFacts: The 2026 NFL Trade Deadline arrives Tuesday, Nov 10 at 1:00 PM PT (4:00 PM ET).
Having already bolstered the interior defensive line via the DeForest Buckner reunion and spring Osa Odighizuwa trade, John Lynch holds $35.16M in gross 2026 cap room.
With four active-roster wideouts ruled Out for Week 9 and Pearsall/Stribling on IR, front office calls center on low-cap-hit boundary WR insurance and swing tackle depth.
schemeAndCapTakeaways: Pro-Rated Base Salary Math: With 9 weeks elapsed in an 18-week season, an incoming player's 2026 cap charge to SF is 9/18ths (50%) of their remaining 2026 base salary plus per-game roster bonuses.
2027 Carryover Tradeoff: Every $1M of unused 2026 cap space rolls dollar-for-dollar into 2027 under CBA Article 13, which Paraag Marathe safeguards to absorb Purdy, Bosa, and Warner option proration.
clusteredBriefs.consensusVsDissent: Beat consensus (Barrows/Maiocco) expects a targeted Day-3 pick move if WR attrition lingers past Sunday against Las Vegas.
